01 / Thanh’s Journey

Where my
curiosity began.

My love for STEM began with childhood LEGO bricks and a supportive mom who gave me opportunities to explore. What started with coding classes and early prototypes grew into a deeper interest in physics and the way things work.

Today, I want to turn that understanding into useful machines and meaningful work with my community.

Building a playground, renovating a library, teaching a first computer class: my community work brings me back to the people behind the problems I want to solve.
